**CLAIM** — session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, branch `claude/issue-4419-detail-header-predicates`.

**Ruling (delegated authority; open veto window)**: fix as the card suggests — the detail header folds `userActionPredicates(objectSchema?.userActions?.delete / .edit)` into `showDelete`/`showEdit`, evaluated against the open record, **through the same helper family the row kebab and RelatedList already use** (one evaluator, one answer across surfaces — no fresh predicate-evaluation code on this path). `disabledWhen` maps to a DISABLED header button, kebab symmetry. The card's ADR-0078 framing is adopted: a key whose scope shrinks when the author upgrades boolean → predicate is silently-inert metadata.

**Scope guards**: (1) #4420 (selection-bar half) is NOT here — it needs the per-record-predicate-over-a-SET semantics decision first and stays its own card. (2) #4296 (row kebab's permission-layer gap) is NOT here. (3) The header's existing gates (`gatedSchema.showDelete ∧ objectAllowsDelete ∧ canDeleteRecord`) all REMAIN — the predicate is a fourth conjunct, not a replacement.

**Red-first (the card's own repro shape)**: record where the predicate is FALSE (paid invoice) → pre-fix the detail header still offers Delete (capture), post-fix hidden. Must-not-change (green both sides): boolean `delete: false` still hides all three surfaces; predicate-TRUE record keeps Delete; `disabledWhen` on edit renders the header Edit disabled (new behavior — red-first it too); permissions/writability gates unchanged.

**Grading**: patch `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (`.d.ts` measured both ways). Never major.

**Surface (mutual exclusion)**: `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` + tests + one changeset. Coordination: in-flight #4468 (date-locale census) was instructed to REPORT rather than edit unexpected surfaces — you own DetailView.tsx; if its census names a date site in your file, it reports and you are unaffected. ⛔ NOT: RelatedList.tsx (already correct — read-only reference), plugin-grid (in-flight #4501 armed), selection-bar components (#4420), console/**, `content/docs/releases/`.
